title: Watch reactive auth state instead of ref.read-ing currentUser inside _AccountTileState.build()
why: SM-3 requires ref.watch in build and ref.read only in callbacks, precisely because a ref.read snapshot of a mutable getter (`.currentUser`, which changes on sign-in/out/re-auth without the authRepositoryProvider instance itself changing) is only re-evaluated when something else this widget DOES watch happens to force a rebuild — not when the underlying session actually changes. The tile's 'valid session' vs 'sign in again' pill/warning-icon can go stale after an auth event (e.g. a sibling tile's re-auth flow) that doesn't independently invalidate this tile.
recommendation: Replace with a watched, narrow selector, e.g. `ref.watch(authStateProvider.select((s) => s.currentUser?.firebaseUid))`, so the tile is reactive to session changes.
acceptance_criteria: A widget test changes the live Firebase session via a provider override while the picker is mounted and asserts the affected tile's badge updates without an unrelated rebuild trigger
